name: Omameter
author: Paulo Busato Favarato
description: Track the usage limits of your AI coding subscriptions (Claude, ChatGPT/Codex, Cursor, Amp, Antigravity, GitHub Copilot, Devin, Grok, Muse Code, Ollama, OpenCode, OpenRouter, Z.ai and CLIProxyAPI hubs) in the Omarchy top bar, with Priority ranking, pace marks, Burning Fast alerts, Unified Accounts, Rate-Limit Resets and the omameter CLI.

barWidget.description: The AI subscription limits closest to running out, right in the Omarchy top bar, with a Priority & All Usage panel, account sign-in manager, pace indicators, notifications and the omameter.limits.v2 CLI.

schema.label: Default tab
schema.description: The tab the panel opens to when clicked from the top bar.

schema.label: Max items in top bar
schema.description: 0 shows the Omameter icon only; up to 5 in single-row Full style or up to 8 in Compact, Icons, or Stacked layouts, followed by a +N overflow count.

schema.label: Always show in top bar
schema.description: Show all Priority items (including Use It or Lose It and Used Up) in the top bar; when off, pinned items and urgent limits appear.

schema.label: Top bar label style
schema.description: Show full metric labels, compact window tags (5h, 7d), or icons only with window glyphs differentiating 5h, session, and weekly limits.

schema.label: Top bar progress meter
schema.description: Add a mini progress bar next to each bounded limit in the top bar: off, graphical bar, Unicode blocks, or slim braille.

schema.label: Top bar layout
schema.description: Single row, or stacked two rows per column to fit more limits in less horizontal space.

schema.label: Provider colors in top bar
schema.description: Tint normal top-bar icons and meters with each provider's signature color; warning and critical alerts still use theme colors.

schema.label: Show usage as
schema.description: Display percentages and amounts as remaining (left) or used.

schema.label: Reset times
schema.description: Show reset times as a relative countdown or exact timestamp.

schema.label: Pace marks
schema.description: Draw a tick on each bar and Priority ring marking where an even pace through the window would be.

schema.label: Warning threshold (% left)
schema.description: Limits at or below this percent remaining turn orange and enter Running Out.

schema.label: Critical threshold (% left)
schema.description: Limits at or below this percent remaining turn red.

schema.label: Burning Fast in Priority
schema.description: List limits projected to run out before their reset at current pace.

schema.label: Use It or Lose It in Priority
schema.description: List multi-day limits resetting within 24 hours with more than 50% left.

schema.label: Notify on Warning
schema.description: Send a desktop notification when a limit reaches the Warning threshold.

schema.label: Notify on Critical
schema.description: Send a desktop notification when a limit reaches the Critical threshold.

schema.label: Notify on Burning Fast
schema.description: Send a desktop notification when current pace will exhaust a limit before reset.

schema.label: Notify on Use It or Lose It
schema.description: Send a desktop notification when a multi-day limit resets within 24h with over 50% left.

schema.label: Notify on Quota Reset
schema.description: Send a desktop notification when a used limit resets and fresh quota becomes available.

schema.label: Privacy mode
schema.description: Show app icon only in the top bar and obscure account names in the panel.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: Background refresh cadence in seconds (default 300s / 5 minutes).

schema.label: Local token analytics
schema.description: Opt-in local scanning of installed AI harness histories (Claude Code, GPT Codex, Antigravity, OpenCode) for token trends and API-equivalent cost estimates.
